title: Gujarat Minister invites Rajasthan CM, Dy CM to Vibrant Summit 2027
excerpt: The Gujarat government has invited Rajasthan Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma and Deputy Chief Minister Diya Kumari to attend the Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit 2027, as the state steps up its efforts to attract investors and strengthen business partnerships ahead of the three-day event in January. Gujarat Labour, Skill Development and Employment, and Rural Development Minister, Kunvarji Bavaliya, along with Shalini Agarwal, managing director of Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (GUVNL), met the two Rajasthan leaders in Jaipur on Friday and formally invited them to participate in the summit. The 11th edition of the Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit will be held from January 10 to 12, 2027, at Mahatma Mandir in Gandhinagar. The event is expected to bring together investors, industrialists, policymakers and representatives from different sectors to discuss investment opportunities, industrial development, innovation and international cooperation. The invitation comes amid Gujarat's wider outreach to domestic and international business communities ahead of the summit. The state government has planned investment outreach across 22 countries and roadshows in eight Indian cities during October and November to engage prospective investors and explore partnerships. The summit, themed "Viksit Gujarat – Shaping Global Future", is intended to promote investment while also focusing on technology, advanced manufacturing, innovation and sustainable growth. Its priority sectors include semiconductors and electronics, artificial intelligence, data centres, aerospace and defence, biotechnology and green energy. The Vibrant Gujarat initiative was launched in 2003, when Prime Minister Narendra Modi was chief minister of Gujarat. Over successive editions, it has developed into a platform for businesses, governments and investors to explore commercial partnerships and discuss the state's industrial development. The Gujarat delegation's visit to Jaipur is also aimed at building on the economic and cultural links between the neighbouring states. Cooperation in investment, trade, industrial growth and skill development could provide avenues for businesses in both states to work together. The summit will be held at Mahatma Mandir Convention and Exhibition Centre in Gandhinagar, with the Vibrant Gujarat Global Trade Show scheduled to be inaugurated at the Helipad Exhibition Centre on January 9, a day before the summit opens.

title: Gujarat Dy CM to hold talks with South Korean firms on investment in technology, textiles
excerpt: Gujarat Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi will hold a series of meetings with South Korean companies in Seoul on Friday to explore investment and industrial collaboration in sectors ranging from advanced technology and artificial intelligence to textiles, biotechnology, electronics and food processing. The high-level delegation, which is visiting South Korea as part of efforts to attract investment under the Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit initiative, is scheduled to hold around 10 one-to-one meetings and roundtable discussions with industry leaders. A business seminar and dinner with members of the Korean industrial community will conclude the day's engagements. The delegation will begin its programme with a breakfast meeting with Jejeong Lee, chairman and chief executive officer of the Advanced Technology Centre Association (ATCA), and leading researchers to discuss potential cooperation in advanced technology. Sanghavi is also scheduled to meet Huh Sung, president and CEO of Kolon Industries, which operates in the chemical and textile sectors, and Stephen Kim, CEO of DeltaX, a company working in artificial intelligence and battery energy storage system (BESS) solutions. The deputy chief minister will visit the headquarters of LS Electric for discussions with its chairman, Ja-Gyun Koo, on investment opportunities in the electronics sector. The delegation will also meet senior executives of Seoul Viosys, a company specialising in advanced technology, and hold discussions with JT Corporation on industrial cooperation. Textile manufacturing will be another focus of the visit. Sanghavi is scheduled to visit the headquarters of Youngone Corporation, a leading South Korean textile company, and meet its chairman, Sung Ki-Hak, to discuss opportunities for expansion in the sector. The delegation will also hold a roundtable with the chief executives of biotechnology companies UMTR, Plantner and Bereum to explore potential areas of cooperation. In the food and confectionery sector, a meeting is planned with Cho Kyung-woon, global business head of Lotte Wellfood, to discuss expansion opportunities. The programme includes a visit to the headquarters of Cosmax, a global manufacturer of beauty and healthcare products, where the delegation will meet the company's vice-chairman. A separate roundtable with South Korean start-ups is scheduled to focus on innovation and the development of Gujarat's start-up ecosystem. The delegation will also meet representatives of leading Korean law firms to discuss regulatory requirements and measures to facilitate investment. The day's engagements will conclude with a business seminar and dinner organised by the Indian Chamber of Commerce in Korea (ICCK), where the delegation is expected to hold discussions with Korean entrepreneurs on industrial partnerships and investment opportunities in Gujarat. The visit is aimed at strengthening economic ties between Gujarat and South Korea and identifying potential areas for investment and collaboration across multiple industries.

title: DK Shivakumar Raises Spyware Concerns, Claims Industrialist Wore Meta AI Glasses During Meeting
excerpt: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister DK Shivakumar has alleged that an industrialist wearing Meta AI smart glasses attempted to secretly record him during a meeting. He also claimed that the visitor had worn the device while meeting Kerala Chief Minister VD Satheesan.

title: Binance's AI-Powered Security Systems Prevent $4.6 Billion in Crypto Losses, Protect 8 Million Users in First Half of 2026
excerpt: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], October 23: Binance, the global blockchain ecosystem behind the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users, revealed that its AI-assisted security systems protected more than 8 million users and prevented approximately $4.6 billion (₹38,640 crore approx.) in potential losses during the first half of 2026, demonstrating how advanced technology is combating crypto-related fraud and scams in real-time.
